type: Horizontal geometric section screen, NOT a slicer/toolpath/physical print
warnings: No physical print or slicer/toolpath certification. Thin railing, lantern lattice, ladder and vane need scale/support assessment.
Opaque windows and lantern glazing are attached exterior conventions; interior stairs, optics and rooms are not reconstructed.
Deck/cornice/roof/canopy overhangs can require supports. Morphological erosion screen is diagnostic only.
Morphological losses include corner erosion and are not a global minimum-wall-thickness proof.
